entry.prompt: Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game: a desert watchtower. One tall, slim, square mudbrick tower, clearly taller than it is wide and slightly tapering, a projecting timber lookout balcony near the top, a flat roof with stepped merlons, a narrow arched door at the base and a turquoise cloth pennant on a pole.

style.suffix: Whitewashed mudbrick walls on a warm sandstone base, flat roofs with low parapets, horseshoe arches, carved timber screens and beams. Chunky low-poly shapes, hard edges, flat faces. Isolated building, no ground, no text, no characters.
style.texture: Stylized matte flat colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Walls: whitewashed render (#EDE4CE). Base, arches and trim: warm sandstone (#C9A876). Timber, screens and beams: weathered mid-brown wood (#8E765F). Domes: pale ochre plaster (#D9C39A). Windows and doorways: dark shadowed brown (#3E352E). Banners and awnings: plain saturated turquoise cloth (#1E8C8C), no emblem. No dirt, text or logos.
